_what: Former lines measured off sheet 1's side view. NOT yet an airframe: nothing maps a former NUMBER to a line, so these are measurements awaiting that mapping.
method: Each former is drawn as two lines ~1/16 in apart (its own thickness); the station is the pair's centre. Found by column darkness over y 230..420 of the rotated side-view crop at 300 dpi.
why_incomplete: The 'YF-578' lettering crosses the fuselage and breaks line detection there. Number-to-line mapping needs the circled digits read, which Hough circles cannot do (it also matches the glyphs '8' and '0').
note: Spacings run 0.60 to 2.25 in, so the formers are NOT evenly spaced: use frames_at, never frames_every. The datum is the crop's left edge, not the aircraft nose; a real airframe needs the datum chosen and the numbers rebased.
